ideas.title: Following the Money: A Deep Dive into Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent investigation into Medicaid fraud in California and explore the larger issue of Medicaid fraud nationwide.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in California?
How does Medicaid fraud affect taxpayers and beneficiaries?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption, and could lead to significant reforms in the Medicaid system.

ideas.title: Government Corruption: A Look at Recent Allegations
ideas.description: This story would explore recent allegations of government corruption, including those against Kristi Noem and the California Mayor.
questions: What are the allegations against Kristi Noem and the California Mayor?
How do these allegations reflect a larger issue with government corruption?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on the pervasive issue of government corruption and the need for increased transparency and accountability.
